summary: P4 wave 2 (AlembicAgent in-process parity plus non-regression), consumes AlembicCore at commit 47391c6 via the at-alembic-core knowledge facade. Add the in-process side of the section 12.5 two-paths-tie parity tripwire: a new additive Agent test asserts that the in-process recipe authoring gate wrapper runInProcessRecipeAuthoringGate in src/tools/runtime/handlers/recipeAuthoringGate.ts produces a verdict byte-identical to a direct Core validateAgainst call with path in-process and the matching opportunistic profile and the same injected ports on a fixture candidate corpus, proving the AlembicAgent in-process submission wrapper faces the same Core bar as the host-agent path and does not mutate the verdict. Together with the Plugin host-path parity test this closes the host-versus-in-process tie transitively, since both wrappers equal the same Core validateAgainst. Non-regression: the Agent test suite stays green and the P1.4b in-process gate wrapper itself is unchanged, that is an additive test only with no wrapper edit. Hard discipline: gates not relaxed, additive test only, if the parity assertion reveals the wrapper diverges from Core validateAgainst then the fix is to make the wrapper call the unified Core validateAgainst rather than relax anything, develop on main only, commit local do not push or tag or bump. Acceptance reference is design section 12.5 and section 10 P1.4 plus the controller P0 oracle at evidence/p0-gate-truth-matrix-2026-06-30.md.
